<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Brick Breaker</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    height: 100%;
    background: #0d1021;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  canvas {
    background: linear-gradient(#141a3a, #0b0e20);
    border: 2px solid #3a4280;
    border-radius: 6px;
    max-width: 98vw;
    max-height: 98vh;
    aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
    cursor: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
  const HUD_H = 40;

  // ---- Level data: '1' = 1-hit brick, '2' = 2-hit brick, '.' = empty ----
  const LEVELS = [
    {
      speed: 360,
      rows: [
        '1111111111',
        '1111111111',
        '1111111111',
        '1111111111',
        '1111111111',
      ],
    },
    {
      speed: 430,
      rows: [
        '....22....',
        '...2112...',
        '..211112..',
        '.21111112.',
        '2111111112',
        '1.1.11.1.1',
        '2.2.22.2.2',
      ],
    },
  ];
  const ROW_COLORS = ['#ff5a5f', '#ff9f43', '#feca57', '#1dd1a1', '#54a0ff', '#a29bfe', '#ff6bcb'];
  const BRICK_COLS = 10, BRICK_H = 22, BRICK_GAP = 6, BRICK_TOP = HUD_H + 40, SIDE_PAD = 30;
  const BRICK_W = (W - SIDE_PAD * 2 - BRICK_GAP * (BRICK_COLS - 1)) / BRICK_COLS;

  // ---- State ----
  let state = 'start'; // start | serve | playing | paused | levelComplete | gameOver | win
  let score = 0, lives = 3, levelIndex = 0;
  let bricks = [];
  const paddle = { w: 110, h: 14, x: W / 2 - 55, y: H - 40, speed: 560 };
  const ball = { x: 0, y: 0, r: 8, vx: 0, vy: 0, speed: 360 };
  const keys = { left: false, right: false };

  function loadLevel(i) {
    levelIndex = i;
    const lvl = LEVELS[i];
    ball.speed = lvl.speed;
    bricks = [];
    lvl.rows.forEach((row, r) => {
      for (let c = 0; c < BRICK_COLS; c++) {
        const ch = row[c];
        if (ch === '1' || ch === '2') {
          const hp = Number(ch);
          bricks.push({
            x: SIDE_PAD + c * (BRICK_W + BRICK_GAP),
            y: BRICK_TOP + r * (BRICK_H + BRICK_GAP),
            w: BRICK_W, h: BRICK_H,
            hp, maxHp: hp, row: r,
            color: ROW_COLORS[r % ROW_COLORS.length],
          });
        }
      }
    });
    resetBall();
  }

  function resetBall() {
    paddle.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - paddle.w, paddle.x));
    ball.vx = 0; ball.vy = 0;
    stickBall();
  }

  function stickBall() {
    ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w / 2;
    ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 1;
  }

  function launch() {
    const angle = (Math.random() * 0.6 - 0.3); // slight random angle from vertical
    ball.vx = ball.speed * Math.sin(angle);
    ball.vy = -ball.speed * Math.cos(angle);
    state = 'playing';
  }

  function newGame() {
    score = 0; lives = 3;
    paddle.x = W / 2 - paddle.w / 2;
    loadLevel(0);
    state = 'serve';
  }

  // Primary action: Space or mouse click
  function action() {
    switch (state) {
      case 'start': newGame(); break;
      case 'serve': launch(); break;
      case 'paused': state = 'playing'; break;
      case 'levelComplete': loadLevel(levelIndex + 1); state = 'serve'; break;
      case 'gameOver':
      case 'win': newGame(); break;
    }
  }

  // ---- Input ----
  window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft' || e.code === 'KeyA') keys.left = true;
    else if (e.code === 'ArrowRight' || e.code === 'KeyD') keys.right = true;
    else if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter') { action(); }
    else if (e.code === 'KeyP' || e.code === 'Escape') {
      if (state === 'playing') state = 'paused';
      else if (state === 'paused') state = 'playing';
    } else return;
    e.preventDefault();
  });
  window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
    if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft' || e.code === 'KeyA') keys.left = false;
    else if (e.code === 'ArrowRight' || e.code === 'KeyD') keys.right = false;
  });
  window.addEventListener('blur', () => {
    keys.left = keys.right = false;
    if (state === 'playing') state = 'paused';
  });

  function canvasX(clientX) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    return (clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
  }
  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
    if (state === 'paused') return;
    paddle.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - paddle.w, canvasX(e.clientX) - paddle.w / 2));
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', e => { e.preventDefault(); action(); });
  // Touch as a bonus
  canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    paddle.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - paddle.w, canvasX(e.touches[0].clientX) - paddle.w / 2));
  }, { passive: false });
  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { e.preventDefault(); action(); }, { passive: false });

  // ---- Update ----
  function update(dt) {
    if (state === 'serve' || state === 'playing') {
      const dir = (keys.right ? 1 : 0) - (keys.left ? 1 : 0);
      paddle.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - paddle.w, paddle.x + dir * paddle.speed * dt));
    }
    if (state === 'serve') { stickBall(); return; }
    if (state !== 'playing') return;

    // Substep so the ball never moves more than half its radius per step
    const dist = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy) * dt;
    const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(dist / (ball.r * 0.5)));
    const sdt = dt / steps;
    for (let i = 0; i < steps && state === 'playing'; i++) step(sdt);
  }

  function step(dt) {
    ball.x += ball.vx * dt;
    ball.y += ball.vy * dt;

    // Walls
    if (ball.x - ball.r < 0) { ball.x = ball.r; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); }
    if (ball.x + ball.r > W) { ball.x = W - ball.r; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); }
    if (ball.y - ball.r < HUD_H) { ball.y = HUD_H + ball.r; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); }

    // Bottom: lose a life
    if (ball.y - ball.r > H) {
      lives--;
      if (lives <= 0) { lives = 0; state = 'gameOver'; }
      else { resetBall(); state = 'serve'; }
      return;
    }

    // Paddle
    if (ball.vy > 0 &&
        ball.y + ball.r >= paddle.y && ball.y - ball.r <= paddle.y + paddle.h &&
        ball.x + ball.r >= paddle.x && ball.x - ball.r <= paddle.x + paddle.w) {
      const hit = (ball.x - (paddle.x + paddle.w / 2)) / (paddle.w / 2); // -1..1
      const angle = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, hit)) * (Math.PI / 3);    // max 60°
      ball.vx = ball.speed * Math.sin(angle);
      ball.vy = -ball.speed * Math.cos(angle);
      ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 0.5;
    }

    // Bricks (one hit per step)
    for (const b of bricks) {
      if (b.hp <= 0) continue;
      const cx = Math.max(b.x, Math.min(ball.x, b.x + b.w));
      const cy = Math.max(b.y, Math.min(ball.y, b.y + b.h));
      const dx = ball.x - cx, dy = ball.y - cy;
      if (dx * dx + dy * dy > ball.r * ball.r) continue;

      const overlapL = ball.x + ball.r - b.x;
      const overlapR = b.x + b.w - (ball.x - ball.r);
      const overlapT = ball.y + ball.r - b.y;
      const overlapB = b.y + b.h - (ball.y - ball.r);
      const ox = Math.min(overlapL, overlapR);
      const oy = Math.min(overlapT, overlapB);
      if (ox < oy) {
        if (overlapL < overlapR) { ball.x -= overlapL; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); }
        else { ball.x += overlapR; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); }
      } else {
        if (overlapT < overlapB) { ball.y -= overlapT; ball.vy = -Math.abs(ball.vy); }
        else { ball.y += overlapB; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); }
      }

      b.hp--;
      score += 10;
      if (b.hp === 0) score += 10 * (LEVELS[levelIndex].rows.length - b.row);
      if (bricks.every(br => br.hp <= 0)) {
        state = levelIndex + 1 < LEVELS.length ? 'levelComplete' : 'win';
      }
      break;
    }
  }

  // ---- Render ----
  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, HUD_H);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#3a4280';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, HUD_H); ctx.lineTo(W, HUD_H); ctx.stroke();

    ctx.font = 'bold 20px "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 16, HUD_H / 2);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Level: ' + (levelIndex + 1) + '/' + LEVELS.length, W / 2, HUD_H / 2);
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5a7a';
    ctx.fillText('♥'.repeat(lives) + '♡'.repeat(3 - lives), W - 16, HUD_H / 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.fillText('Lives:', W - 16 - ctx.measureText('♥♥♥').width - 8, HUD_H / 2);
  }

  function drawBricks() {
    for (const b of bricks) {
      if (b.hp <= 0) continue;
      ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
      ctx.globalAlpha = b.hp < b.maxHp ? 0.55 : 1;
      roundRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 4);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      if (b.maxHp > 1) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = b.hp > 1 ? '#fff' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        roundRect(b.x + 1, b.y + 1, b.w - 2, b.h - 2, 4);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.25)';
      ctx.fillRect(b.x + 3, b.y + 3, b.w - 6, 4);
    }
  }

  function drawPaddle() {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, paddle.y, 0, paddle.y + paddle.h);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#e0e6ff');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#7f8cff');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    roundRect(paddle.x, paddle.y, paddle.w, paddle.h, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawBall() {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.shadowColor = '#9fd3ff';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  }

  function overlay(title, lines, dim = true) {
    if (dim) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(5,8,20,0.7)';
      ctx.fillRect(0, HUD_H, W, H - HUD_H);
    }
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 48px "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, H / 2 - 40);
    ctx.font = '20px "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#c8cff5';
    lines.forEach((l, i) => ctx.fillText(l, W / 2, H / 2 + 15 + i * 30));
  }

  function render() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    drawBricks();
    drawPaddle();
    drawBall();
    drawHUD();

    switch (state) {
      case 'start':
        overlay('BRICK BREAKER', [
          'Move: Mouse or ← → / A D',
          'Launch: Click or Space   •   Pause: P',
          'Click or press Space to start',
        ]);
        break;
      case 'serve':
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.font = '18px "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif';
        ctx.fillStyle = '#c8cff5';
        ctx.fillText('Click or press Space to launch', W / 2, H / 2 + 80);
        break;
      case 'paused':
        overlay('PAUSED', ['Press P or click to resume']);
        break;
      case 'levelComplete':
        overlay('LEVEL ' + (levelIndex + 1) + ' COMPLETE!', ['Score: ' + score, 'Click or press Space for Level ' + (levelIndex + 2)]);
        break;
      case 'gameOver':
        overlay('GAME OVER', ['Final score: ' + score, 'Click or press Space to play again']);
        break;
      case 'win':
        overlay('YOU WIN!', ['Final score: ' + score, 'Click or press Space to play again']);
        break;
    }
  }

  // ---- Loop ----
  let last = performance.now();
  function frame(now) {
    const dt = Math.min(0.033, (now - last) / 1000);
    last = now;
    update(dt);
    render();
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  loadLevel(0);
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.fillText('Lives:', W - 16 - ctx.measureText('♥♥♥').width - 8, HUD_H / 2);

<canvas id="game" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
  const HUD_H = 40;

  // ---- Level data: '1' = 1-hit brick, '2' = 2-hit brick, '.' = empty ----
  const LEVELS = [
    {
      speed: 360,
      rows: [
        '1111111111',
        '1111111111',
        '1111111111',
        '1111111111',
        '1111111111',
      ],
    },
    {
      speed: 430,
      rows: [
        '....22....',
        '...2112...',
        '..211112..',
        '.21111112.',
        '2111111112',
        '1.1.11.1.1',
        '2.2.22.2.2',
      ],
    },
  ];
  const ROW_COLORS = ['#ff5a5f', '#ff9f43', '#feca57', '#1dd1a1', '#54a0ff', '#a29bfe', '#ff6bcb'];
  const BRICK_COLS = 10, BRICK_H = 22, BRICK_GAP = 6, BRICK_TOP = HUD_H + 40, SIDE_PAD = 30;
  const BRICK_W = (W - SIDE_PAD * 2 - BRICK_GAP * (BRICK_COLS - 1)) / BRICK_COLS;

  // ---- State ----
  let state = 'start'; // start | serve | playing | paused | levelComplete | gameOver | win
  let score = 0, lives = 3, levelIndex = 0;
  let bricks = [];
  const paddle = { w: 110, h: 14, x: W / 2 - 55, y: H - 40, speed: 560 };
  const ball = { x: 0, y: 0, r: 8, vx: 0, vy: 0, speed: 360 };
  const keys = { left: false, right: false };

  function loadLevel(i) {
    levelIndex = i;
    const lvl = LEVELS[i];
    ball.speed = lvl.speed;
    bricks = [];
    lvl.rows.forEach((row, r) => {
      for (let c = 0; c < BRICK_COLS; c++) {
        const ch = row[c];
        if (ch === '1' || ch === '2') {
          const hp = Number(ch);
          bricks.push({
            x: SIDE_PAD + c * (BRICK_W + BRICK_GAP),
            y: BRICK_TOP + r * (BRICK_H + BRICK_GAP),
            w: BRICK_W, h: BRICK_H,
            hp, maxHp: hp, row: r,
            color: ROW_COLORS[r % ROW_COLORS.length],
          });
        }
      }
    });
    resetBall();
  }

  function resetBall() {
    paddle.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - paddle.w, paddle.x));
    ball.vx = 0; ball.vy = 0;
    stickBall();
  }

  function stickBall() {
    ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w / 2;
    ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 1;
  }

  function launch() {
    const angle = (Math.random() * 0.6 - 0.3); // slight random angle from vertical

    ball.vy = -ball.speed * Math.cos(angle);

    score = 0; lives = 3;
    paddle.x = W / 2 - paddle.w / 2;

      case 'serve': launch(); break;
      case 'paused': state = 'playing'; break;
      case 'levelComplete': loadLevel(levelIndex + 1); state = 'serve'; break;
      case 'gameOver':
      case 'win': newGame(); break;

  window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft' || e.code === 'KeyA') keys.left = true;
    else if (e.code === 'ArrowRight' || e.code === 'KeyD') keys.right = true;
    else if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'Enter') { action(); }
    else if (e.code === 'KeyP' || e.code === 'Escape') {
      if (state === 'playing') state = 'paused';
      else if (state === 'paused') state = 'playing';

    e.preventDefault();

  window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
    if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft' || e.code === 'KeyA') keys.left = false;
    else if (e.code === 'ArrowRight' || e.code === 'KeyD') keys.right = false;
  });
  window.addEventListener('blur', () => {
    keys.left = keys.right = false;
    if (state === 'playing') state = 'paused';
  });

  function canvasX(clientX) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    return (clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
  }
  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
    if (state === 'paused') return;
    paddle.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - paddle.w, canvasX(e.clientX) - paddle.w / 2));
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', e => { e.preventDefault(); action(); });
  // Touch as a bonus
  canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    paddle.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - paddle.w, canvasX(e.touches[0].clientX) - paddle.w / 2));
  }, { passive: false });
  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { e.preventDefault(); action(); }, { passive: false });

  // ---- Update ----
  function update(dt) {
    if (state === 'serve' || state === 'playing') {
      const dir = (keys.right ? 1 : 0) - (keys.left ? 1 : 0);
      paddle.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - paddle.w, paddle.x + dir * paddle.speed * dt));

    if (state !== 'playing') return;

    const dist = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy) * dt;
    const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(dist / (ball.r * 0.5)));

    for (let i = 0; i < steps && state === 'playing'; i++) step(sdt);
  }

  function step(dt) {
    ball.x += ball.vx * dt;
    ball.y += ball.vy * dt;

    // Walls
    if (ball.x - ball.r < 0) { ball.x = ball.r; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); }
    if (ball.x + ball.r > W) { ball.x = W - ball.r; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); }
    if (ball.y - ball.r < HUD_H) { ball.y = HUD_H + ball.r; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); }

    // Bottom: lose a life
    if (ball.y - ball.r > H) {
      lives--;
      if (lives <= 0) { lives = 0; state = 'gameOver'; }
      else { resetBall(); state = 'serve'; }
      return;
    }

    // Paddle
    if (ball.vy > 0 &&
        ball.y + ball.r >= paddle.y && ball.y - ball.r <= paddle.y + paddle.h &&
        ball.x + ball.r >= paddle.x && ball.x - ball.r <= paddle.x + paddle.w) {
      const hit = (ball.x - (paddle.x + paddle.w / 2)) / (paddle.w / 2); // -1..1

      ball.vy = -ball.speed * Math.cos(angle);
      ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 0.5;
    }

    // Bricks (one hit per step)
    for (const b of bricks) {
      if (b.hp <= 0) continue;
      const cx = Math.max(b.x, Math.min(ball.x, b.x + b.w));
      const cy = Math.max(b.y, Math.min(ball.y, b.y + b.h));

      const overlapR = b.x + b.w - (ball.x - ball.r);
      const overlapT = ball.y + ball.r - b.y;
      const overlapB = b.y + b.h - (ball.y - ball.r);
      const ox = Math.min(overlapL, overlapR);
      const oy = Math.min(overlapT, overlapB);
      if (ox < oy) {
        if (overlapL < overlapR) { ball.x -= overlapL; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); }
        else { ball.x += overlapR; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); }
      } else {
        if (overlapT < overlapB) { ball.y -= overlapT; ball.vy = -Math.abs(ball.vy); }
        else { ball.y += overlapB; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); }
      }

      b.hp--;
      score += 10;
      if (b.hp === 0) score += 10 * (LEVELS[levelIndex].rows.length - b.row);
      if (bricks.every(br => br.hp <= 0)) {

      }

    }
  }

  // ---- Render ----
  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, HUD_H);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#3a4280';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, HUD_H); ctx.lineTo(W, HUD_H); ctx.stroke();

    ctx.font = 'bold 20px "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 16, HUD_H / 2);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Level: ' + (levelIndex + 1) + '/' + LEVELS.length, W / 2, HUD_H / 2);
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5a7a';
    ctx.fillText('♥'.repeat(lives) + '♡'.repeat(3 - lives), W - 16, HUD_H / 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.fillText('Lives:', W - 16 - ctx.measureText('♥♥♥').width - 8, HUD_H / 2);
  }

      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.25)';
      ctx.fillRect(b.x + 3, b.y + 3, b.w - 6, 4);
    }
  }

  function drawPaddle() {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, paddle.y, 0, paddle.y + paddle.h);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#e0e6ff');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#7f8cff');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    roundRect(paddle.x, paddle.y, paddle.w, paddle.h, 7);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  function drawBall() {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.shadowColor = '#9fd3ff';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  }

  function overlay(title, lines, dim = true) {
    if (dim) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(5,8,20,0.7)';
      ctx.fillRect(0, HUD_H, W, H - HUD_H);
    }
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 48px "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif';

    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

    drawPaddle();
    drawBall();

I've written the brick-breaker game to `index.html` in the work folder. It's a single file with no external assets; you open it by double-clicking. I haven't tested it: I didn't open it in a browser, and the JavaScript syntax check needed a permission you didn't grant, so it didn't run.

- **Levels:**
  - Level 1 is 5 rows of 10 bricks that each break in one hit.
  - Level 2 is a pyramid-style layout with outlined bricks that take two hits (they fade after the first), and the ball is faster.
  - Clearing level 1 shows a "Level Complete" screen, then level 2; clearing level 2 shows "You Win".
- **Score:** each hit gives 10 points, and destroying a brick gives a bonus that is bigger for higher rows. The top bar shows score, level and lives.
- **Lives:** you start with 3. A missed ball costs one and puts the ball back on the paddle; at 0 the game ends and you can restart with Space or a click.
- **Keyboard:** ←/→ or A/D move the paddle, Space (or Enter) launches, starts, continues and restarts, and P or Esc pauses.
- **Mouse:** moving the mouse moves the paddle and clicking launches or starts. Both input methods work together.
- **Extras:** where the ball hits the paddle sets its bounce angle (up to 60°), so you can aim. Basic touch control also works, and the game pauses itself if the window loses focus.
